{{Top|leg}}
'''Comm repeaters''' were used to pick up and boost the range of communications networks. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Imperial Prefect]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Eugene Talmont]], ordered the addition of a number of comm repeaters to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The repeaters were encoded for use by the local military and militia forces. [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] such as [[ASP-704]] were tasked with installing them.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
